proposals.evidence: User adjudication fixes the fly lexical parent as uḍḍayate 1697-2, with *uddayati 1697-5 retained as the alternative. The complete expression has fly followed by the perfective gone auxiliary. Turner gata includes western gaya/gyau/giu and the extended Oriya gali/gelā series. Local linking and agreement endings are retained with their stems.
